title: Rig Relay Local Model Comfort Score v1
description: Content-light comfort score for running a model locally on a specific machine profile. No raw prompts, model outputs, source code, diffs, stdout/stderr bodies, secrets, tokens, API keys, or raw private paths.

backend.description: Local backend used to serve the model

memory_headroom_score.description: Score for available memory headroom. 1.0 = ample, 0.0 = insufficient.

speed_score.description: Score for inference speed. 1.0 = real-time capable, 0.0 = unusably slow.

context_score.description: Score for context window capacity. 1.0 = full context fits, 0.0 = context too small.

stability_score.description: Score for runtime stability. 1.0 = no crashes, 0.0 = frequent failures.

comfort_category.description: Overall comfort recommendation for running this model locally

evidence_count.description: Number of observations supporting this comfort score

warnings.description: Human-readable warnings about this comfort score
